info.bio:
The Dead Boys fue una banda de punk rock Estadounidense de la generación del 77 liderada por Stiv Bators.

-FORMACION DEL GRUPO

El guitarrista Cheetah Chrome, y batería Johnny Blitz -junto a quienes posteriormente formarían Pere Ubu, David Thomas y Peter Laughnerl- formaban parte de la banda protopunk Rocket From The Thombs. El grupo resultó demasiado art-rock para Blitz y Chrome, y acabaron abandonando la banda. En el verano de 1975 conocieron a Stiv Bators

scenes.name: La blank generation (Akron, San Francisco, Manhattan)
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: La «blank generation» nace de un vacío moral: la sociedad posindustrial reduce al individuo a un engranaje y la humanidad imagina su mutación en monstruos. La música de la new wave es una de las formas más filosóficas del rock. En Akron (Ohio), Pere Ubu (Modern Dance, «fresco de una civilización al borde del colapso» y folk para la era industrial), Devo, Styrenes, Waitresses, Dead Boys. En San Francisco, el tercer polo: los Residents (Meet The Residents, Not Available, Eskimo), Chrome (space-rock e implosiones industriales), Tuxedomoon, Factrix, Zoogz Rift, Rhythm And Noise, Negativland y Biota. En Manhattan, Suicide (sintetizador y voz; inventan el «psychobilly») y los Feelies.

podcast.title: Shared Stage at The Cramps' First Concert (1976)
podcast.body: The Dead Boys performed alongside The Cramps at The Cramps' inaugural concert in 1976, which took place at CBGB. "Su primer concierto fue en el CBGV junto con los Dead Boys, era 1976."

podcast.title: Cleveland Transplants
podcast.body: The Dead Boys were a band known for their anger and energy, and they were transplants who had moved to New York from Cleveland to play at clubs like CBGB. "There was the anger and the energy of bands like the dead boys who were transplants from Cleveland."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Knife Ownership Inspiring Sid Vicious
podcast.body: Steve Bator's of the Dead Boys owned a 007 hunting knife, which inspired Sid Vicious to purchase a similar one. This knife later became the weapon in Nancy Spungen's murder. "He wanted one because Steve Bader's of the Dead Boys had one."

xref.title: Friends with Blondie and Ramones; Almost Signed to IRS; Influenced B-52s; Background Vocals on Blondie's Autoamerican
xref.body: The B-Girls formed in Toronto in 1977 with a sound closer to British Invasion mid-1960s than hard punk, though their look and attitude were fully punk. They toured with and opened for Teenage Head, the Viletones, and eventually The Clash, then relocated to New York where they became close with Blondie, the Ramones, the Cramps, and the Dead Boys. Members sang background vocals on Blondie's *Autoamerican* (1980), had demos produced by Debbie Harry and Mick Jones of The Clash, and nearly signed with IRS Records — which chose a Los Angeles band called the Go-Go's instead. The Go-Go's were fans of the B-Girls. The B-Girls' existence and sound also influenced a band from Georgia called the B-52s. No album was released before the original lineup fell apart by 1981. "This Canadian punk band influenced not just Blondie and the Go-Go's, but a band visiting New York from Georgia called the B-52s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Nancy Spungen's Murder and Sid Vicious's Arrest
xref.body: Nancy Spungen died on October 12th, 1978, from a single knife wound to her abdomen after a party in their Chelsea Hotel room the previous night, October 11th. Sid Vicious had taken 22 tablets of a powerful sedative and passed out, only to wake up to find Nancy dead on the bathroom floor, covered in congealed blood. The autopsy determined she bled to death over at least three hours. The murder weapon was a 007 hunting knife Sid had purchased on 42nd Street, inspired by Steve Bator's of the Dead Boys. Sid was arrested and charged with second-degree murder, giving inconsistent statements about the event, ranging from not remembering to claiming he did it because he was "a dirty dog" or that she fell on the knife. "The cops were called and Sid was arrested and charged with her murder."
